says: The retro and overhaul countdowns: per kind what it counted since where it starts, the days, and whether it is due or open.
message:
retro: {retro_count} ({retro_landed} landed, {retro_failed} failed) {retro_start}, {retro_days} days; {retro_state}
overhaul: {overhaul_count} retros closed {overhaul_start}, {overhaul_days} days; {overhaul_state}

retro_count.description: The retro's weighted count of what came back, digits alone.

retro_landed.description: How many of those landed, digits alone.

retro_failed.description: How many of those failed, digits alone.

retro_start.description: Where it starts: since which retro started, and when, or in the whole history.

retro_days.description: The days since its start, digits alone.

retro_state.description: open with its open retros, due with its reason, or not due.

overhaul_count.description: How many retros closed since its start, digits alone.

overhaul_start.description: Where it starts: since which overhaul started, and when, or in the whole history.

overhaul_days.description: The days since its start, digits alone.

overhaul_state.description: open with its open overhauls, due with its reason, or not due.
